title: 'Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!' Anime Unveils Cast, October Debut
content: The staff for the television anime of Muchimaro 's Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru! ( There is also a hole in the student organization! ) four-panel manga announced with a character promotional video on Saturday that it has cast Shōgo Sakata as the protagonist Mizunoe Ume.
author: ANN

title: Shonen Jump Hit Anime Shows Off Big Season 3 Makeover – Watch the Trailer
content: One major Shonen Jump franchise is coming back to screens next year with a third season of the anime, and its first trailer is showing off the franchise’s big makeover heading into Season 3.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Most Magical New Anime Debuts First Look Trailer for Season 2 Return – Watch
content: Crunchyroll had made major waves with a magical new anime this year, and fans have gotten the first look at its Season 2 return with a dark new trailer. title: After 49 Years, Star Wars’ New Darth Vader Replacement Changes Everything We Know About the Jedi
content: After 49 years, Star Wars animation is finally taking a step away from the Skywalker saga with The Ninth Jedi . The films may be struggling right now, but the first trailer for The Ninth Jedi was everything we could have hoped for.
author: ComicBook

title: The Elusive Samurai Season 2 Main Trailer Reveals July 17 Premiere
content: The Elusive Samurai Season 2 revealed the main trailer and opening theme song, along with a July 17 premiere date. The sequel was announced immediately after the first season ended in 2024, while the first visual was revealed last December. Today’s announcement was made during Anime Expo 2026.
author: Anime Corner

title: S Rank Bōkensha Dearu Ore no Musume-tachi wa Jūdo no Fathercon Deshita Novels Get TV Anime
content: Novelist Kametsu Tomobashi announced on Saturday that the S Rank Bōkensha Dearu Ore no Musume-tachi wa Jūdo no Fathercon Deshita (My S-Rank Adventurer Daughters Have Serious Father Complexes) light novel series will receive an anime adaptation.
author: ANN

title: Loner Life in Another World Anime Gets 2nd Season
content: The staff for the television anime of Shoji Goji 's Loner Life in Another World ( Hitoribotchi no Isekai Kōryaku ) light novel series announced on Saturday that the series will receive a second season.
author: ANN

title: Chillin' in Another World With Level 2 Super Cheat Powers Anime Gets 2nd Season
content: The staff for the television anime of Miya Kinojo 's Chillin' in Another World With Level 2 Super Cheat Powers ( Lv2 kara Cheat datta Moto Yūsha Kōho no Mattari Isekai Life ) light novel series announced on Saturday that the series will receive a second season.
author: ANN

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Premieres First Episode to Rave Reviews
content: Even before this year’s Anime Expo, Cyberpunk: Edgerunners ‘ highly anticipated sequel was preparing anime fans to return to Night City. Specifically, the Netflix exclusive released a new trailer along with a look at the new characters who are picking up the baton from David and Lucy following their tragic tale.
author: ComicBook
